scope: Read-only source review of v2 and v3; no source edit, build, typecheck, runtime, or patch application
checks: Existing actors, task creation, await/sleep, cancellation calls, guards and application state writes remain in their original order; added scopes/maps are DEBUG diagnostics.

Deferred request association is consumed after existing consumePendingCountdown; visible fallback uses its parent ID, re-request creates an explicitly linked child ID. Synchronous diagnostic scopes do not cross await.

Each existing arm task captures its own scalar attempt ID. A canceled old task cannot clear a new task association through its catch marker. Completed-task mismatch marks ambiguity without changing production control flow.
Context combines the shared coach identity and plan. Single appearance/context and no ambiguity are required for attribution; this is not a unique per-instance identity in unrestricted usage.

v3 returned scene token is an existing DEBUG internal stored UUID (BoardModelRealityScene.diagnosticLifecycleToken), not entity traversal or a strong registry reference. Before/after prepare markers wrap the unchanged call.
No concrete compile error found by reading. No compilation or runtime correctness claim is made.
limits: Synchronous UUID/dictionary/JSON/file-I/O overhead can change wall timing around the existing arm deadline; unchanged scheduling constructs do not prove unchanged timing.
The catch marker name says cancelled, but its Task.isCancelled value and catch context must be retained; not every caught sleep error can be assumed cancellation.

associationValid is context/registry attribution validity only, not proof that an individual event had a nonnil attempt or that an armed task completed. Consumers must retain missing IDs, ambiguity markers, event limit and right-censoring.
No cause, fix, production recommendation or new experiment selected.
